name: GES + size-gated G-test pruning
tagline: Run GES with BDeu, then on graphs with more than 20 variables drop edges that pass a chi-squared CI test conditioned on safe-cardinality neighbour subsets.

key_hyperparams.name: card_budget
key_hyperparams.role: max joint cardinality for valid CI test

diff_from_baseline: Starts from the GES baseline but adds a post-hoc G-test (gsq) edge-pruning pass restricted to neighbourhood-only conditioning sets and only triggered for large graphs.

name: GES + DAG-space refinement
tagline: Convert the GES CPDAG into a DAG by BDeu-comparing each undirected edge, break cycles, then run two passes of greedy add/delete/reverse refinement before CPDAG conversion.

key_hyperparams.name: tie_margin
key_hyperparams.role: BDeu margin for orienting CPDAG undirected edges

key_hyperparams.name: improve_eps
key_hyperparams.role: minimum delta for accepting hill-climbing move

diff_from_baseline: Wraps the GES baseline with a DAG-space hill-climbing refinement (add/delete/reverse) seeded from a BDeu-oriented CPDAG, recovering edges that pure CPDAG-space search misses.

name: MI-restricted permutation BDeu search
tagline: Restrict each node's parent candidates to its top-15 mutual-information neighbours, then optimise permutation order with multi-start best-insert search before a local DAG hill-climb.

key_hyperparams.name: max_pa
key_hyperparams.role: max parents per node in cached subset search

diff_from_baseline: A custom permutation-based discoverer in the BOSS/GRaSP family: replaces the library implementation with an MI-pruned, BDeu-scored best-insert order search over multiple restarts followed by a DAG hill-climb.

name: Reliability-adaptive PC ∩ GES
tagline: Choose alpha by sample-complexity, run PC and GES, intersect their skeletons, keep only consensus arrows plus reliable PC v-structures, then close under Meek.

key_hyperparams.name: small_safeguard
key_hyperparams.role: use union (not intersection) of PC and GES skeletons

init_recovers: PC ∩ GES with fixed alpha; degenerates toward PC at small p
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of PC and GES baselines: instead of running either alone, this proposal intersects their skeletons with a sample-size-adaptive alpha and only orients edges where both methods agree (or PC v-structures are reliable).

name: Multi-alpha skeleton + BDeu hill-climb
tagline: Take the union of three PC skeletons at alpha in {0.005, 0.01, 0.05}, then greedily search a DAG (add/delete/reverse) restricted to that skeleton with BDeu scoring.
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid PC+HC: uses the union of multi-alpha PC skeletons as a hard constraint for an HC-style BDeu hill-climber, intersecting the PC skeleton baseline with the HC search baseline.
